points.text: SC (CJI Surya Kant): cybercriminals have "no space in society"; digital-arrest complaints fell from **1,23,672** (2024) to **16,377** (H1 2026); e-Zero FIR works in 19 States.

points.text: SC clarified its **March 11, 2026** OBC creamy-layer judgment does not require retrospective revision of service allocations/seniority; CSE-2025 results stand.

points.text: CBSE's **2027** Class 10/12 boards begin **16 February** (Class 10 ends 9 March, Class 12 ends 9 April); 26.5 lakh Class 10 and 19.8 lakh Class 12 students registered.

points.text: Centre mandated weekly rice/paddy stock declarations under the **Essential Commodities Act, 1955**; let 5 southern States impose stock limits till Jan 31, 2027; doubled the OMSS e-auction target to 50 lakh tonnes.
points.plain: Centre mandated weekly rice/paddy stock declarations under the Essential Commodities Act, 1955; let 5 southern States impose stock limits till Jan 31, 2027; doubled the OMSS e-auction target to 50 lakh tonnes.

points.text: Sensex +2.17% to **81,028.02**, Nifty +2.01% to **25,030.35** (highest since **March 2**; Nifty's biggest weekly rally of 2026) even as Nasdaq-100 fell 6.36%; rupee hit a 6-month high of **93.89**/$.

points.text: Govt approved 12 more **ECMS** projects, taking total investment commitment to **₹77,051 crore** (118 projects, ~30% above the original target).
